benchmark_configuration.calibration_uncertainty_interpretation: Configured relative scale envelope, not a statistical confidence interval or measured per-camera uncertainty.

metric_semantics.candidate_estimates: Accepted fused density when available, otherwise the unvalidated FFT candidate.
metric_semantics.accepted_measurements: Non-null accepted fusion outputs only. accepted_warp/accepted_weft are rounded integers; accepted_*_continuous preserve the pre-rounding one-decimal consensus. Rejected outputs count against coverage.
metric_semantics.orientation_invariant_paired: Ground-truth-assisted axis swap; offline diagnostic only, never production inference.
metric_semantics.bootstrap: 1000-seed-42 specimen-level clusters (one FabricNET image per sample).

orientation_invariant_paired.policy: Ground-truth-assisted axis swap; offline diagnostic only, never production inference.

comparison_to_committed_benchmark.interpretation: Exact deterministic reproduction compares all fields preserved by the historical benchmark. Continuous accepted consensus values are newly emitted by this runner and were not stored in the historical artifact.
